benchmark.name: FrontierCS 2

summary.en: Tests whether coding agents can deliver open-ended computer-science R&D results inside a real research repository.
summary.zh: 测试 coding agent 能否在真实研究代码仓库中完成开放式计算机科学研发任务。

task_format.en: 48 public tasks across 13 domains such as ML systems, HPC, databases, security and robotics; the agent inherits a working repository, works for up to five hours, and submits a patch.
task_format.zh: 48 个公开任务覆盖 ML 系统、HPC、数据库、安全和机器人等 13 个领域；agent 接手一个可运行的代码仓库，最多工作五小时，然后提交补丁。

explanation.en: Share of the 48 task runs whose final submission passes the hidden-reference judge. The FCI capability index on the leaderboard is a separate IRT scale and is not used here.
explanation.zh: 48 个任务运行中，最终提交通过隐藏参考答案评审的比例。榜单上的 FCI 能力指数是另一种 IRT 量表，这里不使用。

observations.evaluation_protocol: Official FrontierCS 2 leaderboard; 48 public tasks, one five-hour run per task, each agent in its own vendor harness; pass rate is passing runs divided by 48.
observations.eligibility_reason: Capability eligibility uses the dated curated observation and canonical protocol; reported-result eligibility requires result_public_date.
observations.notes: Operational evaluation timeline only; not a historical public-result date.

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
